question: What digital photos must an Express Entry applicant provide?

claims.text: Digital photos meeting IRCC's permanent resident card photo specifications must be provided.
claims.quote: * Digital photos meeting [IRCC’s permanent resident card photo specifications (PDF, 614.24 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/information/applications/guides/pdf/5445eb-e.pdf) must be provided.

basis: The applicant submitted a 2-page PDF document (opaque case ID 567864bdadffc58ba6391652a353fb8f) for the digital_photo document upload slot.
The uploaded file 567864bdadffc58ba6391652a353fb8f.pdf contains 2 pages with embedded photo image objects (Page 1: 2562x3311 pixels; Page 2: 2590x3333 pixels).
